limitations: Neutral Minecraft bean exposes no absolute tick counter. Validated contiguous changed slots provide observed completed-tick samples; identical-nanosecond overwrites and an undetectable full wrap cannot be ruled out mathematically. CPU is whole Server-thread counter delta normalized by observed completed ticks, includes between-tick work, and has partial-tick boundary uncertainty. GC collection time is an MXBean aggregate, not pause quantiles. JMX polling overhead is present equally in all test variants; use read latency and sequence validity to reject poor windows.
